package.name: odin1_control
package.description: ROS 2 control surface for the Odin1 module. Builds as a static library that is linked into the vendor driver executable (host_sdk_sample), because the USB device handle is process-local: only one process may hold the device. Replaces the driver's /tmp/odin_command.txt file channel with services and actions for save_map, switch_mode, load_map, set_init_pose, reset_algo and get_device_state.
